# Native plug-in cache

Generated by libVLC 3.0.24 x64 with `--reset-plugins-cache`, using the unmodified VideoLAN.LibVLC.Windows 3.0.24 NuGet plug-ins. It contains relative paths and metadata, not copied application settings. The upstream source and license are supplied under `third_party`.

`Publish.ps1` compares every plug-in's SHA256, length and timestamp with `plugins-manifest.json` before deploying this cache. NuGet DLL timestamps have two-second ZIP precision, so extracting the published ZIP preserves the cache's timestamp checks. libVLC independently rejects stale per-module cache entries at runtime.

To regenerate after a libVLC upgrade, build the application with that native version, run `UltraLightWallpaper.exe --prepare-native-cache` in an approved build environment, copy `libvlc/win-x64/plugins/plugins.dat` here, and regenerate the manifest from those same DLLs. Do not reuse this cache for another version or architecture.
